sentences.text: Shri S. Paliwal, Advocate for petitioner.

Shri M.K. Pathan, Additional Public Prosecutor for
 respondents.

--------
 Coram : P.N. Deshmukh And
 Pushpa V. Ganediwala, Jj.
Dated : July 24, 2019

With reference to earlier order dated 17/7/2019 passed by this Court, Shri Paliwal, learned Counsel for petitioner, on instructions, seeks leave to withdraw the petition since it is rendered infructuous, with liberty to take appropriate steps, if required, on issuance of notice, if any, under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The petition is disposed of as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
